name: Seals
overview: Scripture reveals that seals, often called signets, served as authoritative marks of ownership, security, and identity, as seen when Pharaoh placed his ring on Joseph's hand to signify royal authority (Genesis 41:42). They were attached to covenants, royal decrees, and property transfers, underscoring their role in legal and sacred transactions (Genesis 38:18, 25; Exodus 28:11). Seals also symbolized what was dear or valued, being set upon treasures and used to ensure secrecy and full approval (Deuteronomy 32:34). Frequently fashioned from precious stones and worn as rings or bracelets, seals conveyed restraint and divine appropriation, reflecting the believer's identification with God by the Spirit.
